messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · Swap price gap exceeds agent waiver limit; order a month past its date; customer

Robert, I'm sorry. Shop···· still hasn't shipped. It's been waiting on one thing since October 29: a senior sign-off for the free Thor P2 swap you accepted. That swap covers a bigger price difference than I'm allowed to approve on my own.

You've been chasing this since October 8, and the order is now a month past its October 15 date. I've sent it to the team again today with the whole history. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you an answer. As soon as it's approved, I'll make the swap, and the Thor P2 ships from the US shelf.

I understand, Robert. I sent your case to the team a minute ago and marked it as needing an answer today. I can't make anyone reply faster from here, and I'm not going to pretend I can.

Would a phone call help? If you send me a good number and a time that suits you today, I'll add it to your case so whoever picks it up can call you instead of emailing.
Is there a number for your office
Handed to the team · Customer wants a person by phone; still no contact 1.5 hours after the money fla

I'm sorry, Robert. I don't have an office number I can give out. I've just told the team that you want to speak to someone by phone, and that nobody has reached you since I sent your case over at 12:37.

If you send me the best number for you and a time that works today, I'll add it to your case. Then whoever picks it up has what they need to call you, and you'll still get their answer by email either way.
I dont care about a call if they won't answer your message or email why bother acting like they will call

You're right, Robert, and I won't promise a call that might not happen. The Thor P2 swap still needs a sign-off I can't give, and the team has it.

There are two things I can do myself right now, if either helps. I can swap the QX1 for a Hammer BC04, which is in stock and ships within 2 business days. Or I can turn the full $278 into store credit on your account, to use on your next order.

If neither suits you, the free Thor P2 offer still stands. It's the team's to approve.
It's seems like you over reached when you offered the p2 and the co.pant is just waiting for me to ask for a refill

You're partly right, Robert. The free Thor P2 was offered before anyone with the authority to approve it had signed off. That was wrong, and it's left you stuck for over two weeks. I'm sorry.

I don't believe anyone is waiting you out, but I can see why it looks that way. The offer is still open, and your case is with the team now.

It's your call. You can keep waiting on the Thor P2, or take the BC04 or the store credit today. If you'd rather have something else, tell me and I'll pass that on exactly as you put it.
I want what I ordered or what you offered  if in the beginning someone has said sorry we can't make that swap I would have understood but 2 weeks have gone by
Handed to the team · Waiver of $101 is over the $100 agent cap; customer declined the BC04 and store

That's fair, Robert, and you shouldn't have been left guessing for two weeks. Someone should have given you a straight yes or no on October 29.

I've passed your decision to the team as you put it: the QX1 you ordered, or the free Thor P2 you were offered. I told them the Thor P2 is on the US shelf now, so only their approval is needed. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you with an answer by email. Once it's approved, I'll make the swap and it ships within 2 business days.
